title: Motion
description: full = a released key's underline lets go softly and a new peak is marked (the release fade only below 16 keys per second). reduced = the block still fades in and out; no release fade or peak mark. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Corner marks
description: The 18-LAB registration marks on the box's top-left and bottom-right corners. neutral = warm white. amber = both in 18-LAB amber. tl = amber, top-left only. none = no marks.

title: Orientation
description: auto: follows the page's box (wider than tall: one row per key, presses travel sideways; otherwise one column per key, presses travel up or down). Without the tape (osu!mania by default) auto always lays the caps out as one row of columns. Size the source or layer to change it.

title: Caps side
description: Where the key caps sit; presses travel away from them. auto: left when horizontal, bottom when vertical. start: left / top. end: right / bottom.

title: Scroll speed
description: How fast presses travel along the tape, in pixels per real second at the overlay's natural size (it scales with the page; rate mods are compensated). osu!catch runs at a quarter of this, because catch keys are held for seconds. 100–3000.

title: Show press counts
description: Presses of this attempt under each key label.

title: Press tape in osu!mania
description: Also draw the scrolling press tape in osu!mania. Off: caps and counts only, because the stage beside it already shows the same notes; on is for replay review.

title: Smoke lane (osu!)
description: Adds a lane for the osu! smoke key.

title: Keys per second
description: Live and peak keys per second (the same number as key-counter and kps-graph).
